items.item:
10. A03-1, A03-2: Inspected from outside it, each execution's environment has no network
    interface but its own loopback, mounts no host directory except the read-only runtime and its
    exchange directory, and has an exchange directory no other execution used.
    [witness: verification:kernel_a03_fresh_env_no_network_no_host_mounts]

verdicts.item:
10. A03-1, A03-2: Inspected from outside it, each execution's environment has no network
    interface but its own loopback, mounts no host directory except the read-only runtime and its
    exchange directory, and has an exchange directory no other execution used.
    [witness: verification:kernel_a03_fresh_env_no_network_no_host_mounts]
verdicts.why: The check restricts interfaces to loopback, restricts mounts to runtime paths plus each execution's exchange directory, and detects exchange-directory reuse. It does not assert that runtime mounts are read-only, that the environment contains exactly the named runtime/code/inputs/exchange/proc components, or that its environment variables are exactly PYTHONHASHSEED=0.
